name: Kawage (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kawage town emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a winged device with a triangle.
history: Flag of the former town of Kawage in Mie Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 June 1959.

features.role: Kawage town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a winged device with a triangle
